messages:
raj_support: Escalation -> GlossCo onboarding blocked by SSO (OIDC) on mobile. Go-live in 3 days, customer hitting 500s on /auth/oidc/callback. Marking P1 and handing to CS for comms + exec escalation. Logs show redirect_uri mismatch. @sophie_csm @maria_cs please advise on comms and exec call.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0623. PagerDuty notified and assigned to support oncall.

oliver_se: Looking into logs now. Snippet: 
```
ERROR 2026-06-30T20:05:12Z AuthError: invalid_request - redirect_uri mismatch for client glossco-mobile-1
```
Quick mitigation: add https://mobile.glossco.app/oidc/callback to allowed redirect URIs as a temporary change. Need customer approval due to security policy. If approved, change + smoke tests should take ~30m.

raj_support: client_id is glossco-mobile-1. Customer says their security team requires a formal review before we add new redirect URIs — that's the blocker. They're worried about wildcard redirects.

sophie_csm: Ok. I'll set up an emergency call with GlossCo security lead and their PM. Need a short comms template for their execs and product team: impact, temporary mitigation, ETA, and possible billing/renewal implications. @amanda_csm can you draft one?

amanda_csm: Drafted a quick comms/exec note: 
"We understand the outage is blocking your mobile go-live. Our engineers have identified a redirect URI mismatch as the root cause. Temporary fix: add a single, specific redirect URI for the mobile client during a 30-minute maintenance window tonight. If security cannot approve that path, we can implement an OAuth PKCE fallback for the mobile app within 48 hours. We will prioritize this and keep you updated every 2 hours."
I'll attach the draft to the calendar invite.

maria_cs: Flagging renewal risk: GlossCo renewal is Oct 1. If go-live slips by >2 weeks, finance will request concession. We need to aim for 48h resolution to avoid escalation. Scheduling a call with GlossCo PM + security tomorrow 10am PST — will invite account execs. @sophie_csm please confirm availability.

sophie_csm: Confirmed for 10am PST. I'll lead the call and share the comms. Oliver, can you prepare a rollback plan and a short status slide for execs?

oliver_se: Rollback plan: remove the temporary redirect from provider config and revert to previous allowed list. No DB migrations, client secret unchanged. We'll snapshot provider config before change. Change window ETA: 30m including smoke tests. I'll prepare a one-slide summary.

raj_support: Customer approved an immediate maintenance window for tonight 11pm PST. Please follow the change checklist: pre/post smoke tests, rotation handoff, update status page, and post-change verification on iOS + Android. I'll update INC-2026-0623 with the schedule and attach smoke-test steps.

deploy-bot: Maintenance window scheduled: 2026-06-30T23:00Z to 2026-06-30T23:30Z. Reminder scheduled for 1h prior.

sophie_csm: Great. I'll send the exec comms now and add renewal risk to the CS tracker. @maria_cs @amanda_csm add follow-ups: billing hold if slip >2 weeks and personalized QBR invite with timeline.

raj_support: After change I'll run a canary auth flow and post logs here. Please also verify Android and iOS builds using the staged client config.

oliver_se: I'll be on standby during the window and able to rollback immediately if anything unexpected. :thumbsup:

sophie_csm: Thanks team. I'll close the loop after the maintenance and follow up with GlossCo execs. If anyone sees social/partner chatter, ping me immediately so we can coordinate external comms.
